components.label: Plan facade

components.label: Persistent history

components.label: Source snapshot

components.label: Plan compiler
components.responsibility: Reverse the operation history once; coalesce only adjacent map descriptors into iterative map runs. Never hoist a filter or recursively nest a long composed function.

components.label: Fused driver
components.responsibility: For each source item, thread one local value through map runs and filters; rejected items continue the outer source loop.

components.label: Output ordinal

components.label: Exception boundary
components.responsibility: Use normal propagation through the terminal loop; discard the terminal-local accumulator and preserve the immutable plan.

components.label: Fresh traversal factory

components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Cursor factory
components.responsibility: Retain immutable operator descriptors; create a pull machine per consumer whose next() resumes at the next accepted output.

components.label: Descriptor spine
components.responsibility: Append a descriptor cell with a previous pointer; it describes a cursor factory and holds no live cursor.

components.label: Cursor allocator
components.responsibility: Flatten descriptor spine once when opening a consumer; allocate source index and output ordinal privately.

components.label: next state machine
components.responsibility: next() loops source candidates and runs descriptors until one survives, then suspends with the next source index.

components.label: Map-run executor
components.responsibility: Compile adjacent map descriptors into array runs; evaluate each user callback in order for only the pulled candidate.

components.label: Pull search
components.responsibility: indexOf calls next until Object.is succeeds, then closes that consumer; no extra next call is made.

components.label: Cursor close
components.responsibility: Set closed before dropping retained temporary references; next after close returns done, while a new consumer remains valid.

components.label: Collector
components.responsibility: Collect repeatedly calls next into one terminal-owned output array; no map or filter owns an intermediate collection.

requirements.text: map/filter append in O(1) without invoking user callbacks; branches cannot mutate another chain.
indexOf short-circuits in output order; collect traverses once with no intermediate arrays.
Fuse adjacent maps without moving callbacks across filters; define repeat consumption, callback exceptions and source ownership.

problem.scope: Authored implementation study of the catalogue LazyArray interface. Compare a persistent operation plan executed in one fused loop with immutable pull-cursor factories. No distributed components, implicit memoization or parallel evaluation. indexOf returns the index in the transformed, filtered output and uses Object.is equality; collect starts a fresh traversal.
